title: fix(desktop): retry a save whose rename an SMB share refused (#5322)
issueTitle: [Bug] 0.20.0-rc.2: saving files on an SMB/UNC path fails with EPERM (regression from #4778)
why: The bug only happens when saving a file to an SMB/UNC network share on Windows, which needs a network server, a specific operating system and file saving, and none of these can be checked from inside the editor.
